notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.3.0 Update - Cheat Codes
notes.content:
Today's update adds a new Cheat Code screen! [spoiler]On the Difficulty Selection Screen, press Down four times while on the bottom row to reveal the Cheat Code menu.[/spoiler] This hidden screen lets you enable or disable gameplay modifiers that can dramatically change how the game plays. Note: playing with a cheat code enabled disables stats and achievements. The in-game timer will also display asterisks next to the time to indicate cheats are active. Cheats are temporary and reset when you quit out of a mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983839/dd34ab19838db3c91289213cad56e9f8db84b13e.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]What's next:[/h3]
This update wraps up the main post-launch content I had planned for the game. Huge thanks to everyone who's played and supported it so far--it seriously means a lot! I'll soon be shifting more of my focus to a new project, but I'll still be around to fix any bugs or issues that come up. Bringing the game to consoles is something I'd really love to do, so I'm exploring this possibility as well (fingers crossed!). This game is extremely special to me, but to keep growing creatively and professionally, I need to continue expanding my catalogue. I'd love to return with a big update in the future if the opportunity arises. Stay tuned!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Cheat Codes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Starting Stage:[/b] Practice the MARATHON modes from any starting stage.
[*] [b]Instant Animation:[/b] Disable animation delay making any mode play like INSTANT mode.
[*] [b]Board Width:[/b] Change the width of the board
[*] [b]Board Height:[/b] Change the height of the board
[*] [b]Hold Piece:[/b] Enable or disable hold piece
[*] [b]Next Pieces:[/b]  Set the number of next pieces to display
[*] [b]Rotation System:[/b] [list]
  [*] MODERN - Standard kick table with modified I piece rotations
  [*] ARCADE - Classic arcade style rotations
  [*] CONSOLE - Classic console style rotations
  [*] CELL - Modern rotations with modified piece set[/list][*] [b]Piece Locking:[/b][list]
  [*] MODERN - Lock delay resets when a piece moves to a new position / rotation
  [*] ARCADE - Lock delay resets when a piece moves down 
  [*] CONSOLE - No lock delay. This setting also changes gravity speed to use CONSOLE settings.[/list] [*] [b]Spawn Alignment:[/b] Change whether or not the pieces spawn left or right aligned
[*] [b]Spawn Canceling:[/b] Enable or disable spawn canceling
[*] [b]Shape Randomizer:[/b][list]
  [*] MODERN - The 7-bag algorithm
  [*] ARCADE - History based algorithm with 4 piece history
  [*] CONSOLE - Modified history based algorithm with 1 piece history
  [*] RANDOM - Pure (memoryless) random. Not used in any mode.[/list][/list]
If you're wondering what to try out with this new feature, here are some of the combinations I've found that are fun!
[list]
[*]INSTANT mode with a 20 wide board requires you play in a very different way
[*]STANDARD mode with a 4 wide board is fun for combo chasing
[*]CHAOS mode with a 5x10 board (BIG CHAOS)
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Hotfix 1.3.1:[/b] Fixed a configuration file mistake causing the 'Mountain' color palette unlock for Tetrachrome/Wild to be associated with Tetrachrome/Chaos
[*] [b]Cheat Codes Screen:[/b] accessible by [spoiler]pressing down 4 times[/spoiler] at the bottom row of the Difficulty Select Screen (full version only)
[*] [b]Access Records from the Game Over Screen:[/b] holding down at the Game Over screen now brings up the Records Screen.
[*] [b]Advanced Options:[/b] Moved the 'Clear Save' option to a new 'Advanced Options' screen.
[*] [b]Unlock Everything:[/b] Added 'Unlock Everything' option to the 'Advanced Options' screen. This unlocks all blocks, palettes, modes, and difficulties (full version only)
[*] [b]Initial Rotation, Hold, Movement Defaults Change for INSTANT Mode:[/b] The initial rotation, hold, and movement options are now off by default in INSTANT mode.

[i]Developer's Note: These were previously on by default in all modes, but I found they feel unintuitive in INSTANT mode. Without spawn delay, it’s easy to accidentally trigger inputs just by releasing buttons too late. This change sets these options to a new ‘AUTO’ setting, which disables them in INSTANT mode by default. If you had these set to 'ON', they will now be set to 'AUTO.' You can switch them back to 'ON' if you want that behavior in INSTANT mode.[/i]

[*] [b]Loading Screen Branding:[/b] Added sparsevector branding to the loading screen.
[*] [b]Credits Update:[/b] Added reference to Mutopia Project in the game's credits.
[*] [b]Demo Update:[/b] The demo has been updated and is available again: the demo has the same content as before (Marathon/Standard and 15 puzzles), but now incorporates all the full release changes. The demo now lists the full game's other modes in the menu to better preview the features of the full version.
[*] [b]Achievement Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where getting the exact required time or line clear count wouldn't trigger the corresponding achievement
[*] [b]Minor Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where editing the noise, wild, or negative piece probabilities could cause the game to hang
[*] [b]Minor Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where sound style unlocks were not being stored properly in the save file.
[*] [b]Minor Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where resetting the gameplay preferences then editing them again would cause UI issues
[*] [b]Minor Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where the vertical alignment of the next / hold piece was off center for the I piece in ARCADE mode
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.2.3 Update - Custom Music
notes.content:
Today's update adds some new quality of life features, with the biggest being new support for custom soundtracks. Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

[b]Update:[/b] There were a couple bugs and unexpected corner cases with the custom soundtrack feature, but I think these are all fixed with the hotfixes. Sorry about the flurry of small patches!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Custom soundtrack support[/b]: The game now has support for custom music! To add your own music to the game follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Right click the game from your Steam library, click [b]Manage[/b], then click [b]Browse Local Files[/b].
[*] Double click to open the [b]Custom [/b] folder, and then open the [b]Music [/b]folder contained within the "Custom" folder. 
[*] [b]Place your music here![/b] The game supports ".mp3", ".flac", and ".ogg" format files.
[/olist]
This directory also contains a README.txt containing information on how to setup custom title and game over screen music.
[*] [b]Mute when window inactive[/b]: The audio options screen now has an option, 'Mute when window inactive' that mutes all audio when the window does not have keyboard focus. This option is off by default. This option is useful if you occasionally need to tab out of the game.
[*] [b]Options reset buttons[/b]: The audio options, controls handling, gameplay preferences, graphics options, and visuals options screens now have 'Reset' buttons to set options to their default values.
[*] [b]Credits cleanup[/b]: Moved the 'Scroll Paintings' credits list to the 'Chaos Mode' section.
[*][b]Hotfix[/b]: Going back and forth between the options and title menu no longer cycles custom music.
[*][b]Hotfix 1.2.4[/b]: Fixed an issue with using custom music with only a single song.
[*][b]Hotfix 1.2.4[/b]: When using custom music with custom title, game over, completion, credits, or tutorial music, this music is excluded from the gameplay music pool.
[*][b]Hotfix 1.2.5[/b]: Fixed an issue where the custom music would only play from the alternate save folder location.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.2.2 Update - ARCADE Mode Synchros
notes.content:
Today's update adds a new mechanic specific to ARCADE mode called synchro moves (also just called synchros). Synchros are an advanced high gravity technique originally found in classic arcade stacker games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983839/f60e3a8755d0661681bdb86a48584f06f280aef3.gif[/img]
[i]An 'auto synchro' is used to 'skip' the I piece over the small gap.[/i]

[quote]
[b]Background on Synchros in Classic Games:[/b] In classic titles, a synchro is performed by rotating and shifting a piece within the same 60Hz frame. Because gravity only applies once per frame, this allows for high gravity movements that would otherwise be impossible. It’s somewhat like a 'combo'. Because the mechanic is tied to the game's framerate, certain synchros ('manual synchros') require frame perfect inputs in classic games.
[/quote]
[b]Tetrachroma's Synchro Design:[/b] Because Tetrachroma is designed for modern, high-refresh rate displays, the traditional frame-based approach doesn't translate well. Instead, the game uses an adjustable 'synchro window'. This approach decouples synchros from the game's framerate and gives players more control over the game's feel. 

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Synchros added to ARCADE mode[/b]: In ARCADE mode, pressing rotate or shift to move a piece "into the air" starts a synchro window. More technically, the button press must move the piece out of a soft lock state. During this window, gravity is delayed. If a second input (either another button press or an auto shift) occurs within this window, a synchro may be performed:
[list]
[*] [b]Auto Synchro[/b]:  Triggered when the first input is a rotation and second is an auto shift.
[*] [b]Manual Synchro[/b]: Triggered when both inputs are manual button presses. There are two ways to do this: rotate-then-shift or shift-then-rotate. (Unlike in classic games, the order matters.)
[/list]
Note that double-shift and double-rotate synchros are not allowed.
[*] [b]Synchro Move Sound Effect[/b]: If a synchro move changes the piece’s resulting position or rotation (e.g. allowing the piece to “jump” a gap), a sound effect will play. This audio cue helps players recognize and learn synchros more easily.
[*] [b]Synchro Window Size Option[/b]: The 'Controls Handling' options screen now includes a user configurable 'Arcade Synchro Window' setting. The default value is 1 frame, but I encourage you to also try out 2 or 3 frames for a looser game feel with easier manual synchros. Setting it to 0 disables the mechanic entirely. Note the size is specified in 60Hz frames for convenience, but the mechanic is not tied to the game's frame rate.
[/list]
[b]Why not add synchros to all the modes?[/b] I tested this out! I found that when paired with the much more flexible rotations of the other modes, auto synchros made the other modes feel a bit too floaty. This might be something I revisit, but for now synchros are an ARCADE mode specific feature. I also think it's cool to make the ARCADE mode even more unique.

With a new design to a classic feature, some fine-tuning may still be needed, so your feedback is greatly appreciated.  I think the mechanic adds an exciting layer of control depth to ARCADE mode, and I'm eager to see how players use it!

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.2.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Just a quick update to address a scoring bug and some other minor fixes. Happy stacking and thanks for the support!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where line clears greater than 4 didn't count for back to back
[*] [b]Minor Fixes[/b]: Fixed a bug that caused the spin sound effect to incorrectly play in certain circumstances when using initial rotation when the spawn location is blocked.
[*] [b]Minor Fixes[/b]: The 'ceiling' above the board no longer counts as occupied for purposes of checking occupied spin corners.
[*] [b]Minor Fixes[/b]: Achieving a high score and then completing the tutorial no longer causes a high score message to display
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.2.0 Update - Sound Styles
notes.content:
This update adds the ability to play any of the game's 8 modes with the "sound style" from another mode. I also added a new extra sound style! Thanks for the support and feedback!

[b]Changes:[/b]  
[list]
[*] [b]Sound Style Preferences[/b]: Sound styles can now be selected from the preferences screen similar to block styles. Unlocking a mode unlocks its sound style for use in other modes.
[*] [b]New Extra Sound Style[/b]: A new sound style called 'ADVENTURE' is unlocked by default.

[i]Developer's note: This new sound style is based on heavily manipulated sounds from my previous game. Given how different they are, I didn't expect many players to have played my last game, but there are more of you than I expected! <3[/i]

[*] [b]New Record Display[/b]: Text now appears on the game over / completion screen when the you achieve a new max score, fastest time, max lines, or max clear.
[*] [b]More Mechanics Information[/b]: Additional gameplay mechanics information is now displayed on the mode selection screen. (e.g., rotation system, randomizer) 
[*] [b]Improved Undo Consistency[/b]: The "Undo" mechanic no longer changes the next piece in Arcade and Console modes.

[i]Developer's note: Previously, "Undo" did not affect the game's random number generator which led to some inconsistencies in how it interacted with the next piece queue. Now "Undo" affects the random number generator, so the piece queue behavior is consistent across modes. [/i]

[*] [b]Improved Arcade Stick Inputs[/b]: A debounce filter is now applied to controller button inputs to improve performance with certain controllers.

[i]Developer's note: Some arcade stick controllers can produce "bounce" input noise (also called chatter"), causing very fast unintended on-off input sequences. Games with 60Hz input polling are rarely affected by this noise, but Tetrachroma's unlocked framerate and event-based input system made it more sensitive. The new debounce filter is designed to have a similar debounce effect to 60Hz polling while preserving the benefits of the unlocked, event-based approach. The filter only engages after detecting bounce controller inputs, so it does not introduce input delay or alter normal input timing. P.S. I bought an arcade stick :)[/i]

[*] [b]Minor Fixes[/b]: Fixed a typo in an option description 
[*] [b]Minor Fixes[/b]: Fixed a misalignment of BIG mode's block flipping sound which was causing audio pops.

[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.1.6 Hotfix
notes.content:
I'm working on bigger update but wanted to push this small gameplay bug fix out before then. Thanks to Kero for spotting this!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug affecting spin detection which caused detection to be too lenient in certain cases, especially with "mini" spins.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.1.4 Update - New Ghost Piece Design
notes.content:
Today's update adds a new default ghost piece behavior along with some small changes. I think this new ghost piece design gives a noticeable improvement to game feel, especially in the CONSOLE and ARCADE modes, but if you'd prefer the old behavior there's an option for that as well!

With this update I think Tetrachroma will be entering a new phase of development with less frequent but larger updates. There aren't as many small issues to address, so I have more time to work on expanding and improving the game in larger ways. I'm excited! I am currently planning a fun update which I hope to have available within a week or two. I'm also going to spend more time promoting the game to grow the Tetrachroma community.

Thank you all for your feedback and support!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hotfix 1.1.5[/b]: Fixed a positioning error of the I piece in the next / hold window in ARCADE mode.
[*] Reworked the ghost piece display with a new default option for improved game feel. Previously the ghost piece option had "OFF" or "ON" settings. The new setting allows for "OFF", "ALWAYS ON", "FLASH ON SPAWN", or "APPEAR ON SPAWN" with a new default setting of "FLASH ON SPAWN". The old behavior is retained with the "ALWAYS ON" setting.

[i]Developer's note: The old default behavior of the ghost piece was unusual in that it appeared as soon as the piece started to spawn. This was an intentional choice to allow the player to react immediately and move the piece as it is spawning with the game's spawn delay canceling feature. But, this 'always on' design gave no indication of the spawn delay duration which could make the controls feel slow in certain circumstances. The new default 'flash on spawn' design attempts to address this. Additionally the new 'appear on spawn' option allows for the more traditional ghost piece behavior for players that prefer it.[/i]

[*] Added Max Gravity Ghost Piece option, defaults to "ON".

[i]Developers note: This change ties into the previous change. Some players prefer to disable the ghost piece at max gravity (20G) because it is not as useful for gameplay at this gravity and can hurt the game feel by obscuring the rhythm of the spawn timing. I'm leaving the default to "ON" for now but may change this depending on community feedback.[/i]

[*] Modified Level 12 announcement sound to make it more clear that the slower gravity at level 12 is intentional
[*] Settings and Mode Selection menus now "wrap around"
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.1.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Just a small update fixing a compatibility issue with display scaling and a bug. Thanks for the reports and support, and let me know if you run into any issues. Keep on stacking!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the game process to be "DPI aware" which should fix compatibility issues with Windows display scale settings
[*] Fixed a bug that caused piece motion after images to display above their correct position in high gravity speeds.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.1.0 Update - New Control Options
notes.content:
Medium sized update adding some new control options along with some miscellaneous fixes. The biggest new feature is the ability to edit control handling on a per mode basis. Let me know in the Steam forums if you encounter any issues. Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

[b]Hotfix 1.1.2:[/b] Corrected an issue preventing saving with non ASCII-characters in the path.
[b]Hotfix 1.1.1:[/b] The update accidentally included a test pattern in place of Puzzle 1--ooops! this has been corrected! Sorry!

[list]
[*] Added the ability to set mode-specific control handling overrides. Access this feature from the new "Mode-Specific Handling Screen" in the Controls options menu.
[*] The soft drop lock setting has been expanded to support "OFF", "ON PRESS OR HOLD", or "ON PRESS". "ON PRESS" replicates the old setting of "ON" while "ON PRESS OR HOLD" is a new behavior meant to be more accurate to classic arcade stackers. 
[*] Added options to disable initial hold, initial movement, initial rotation from the controls handling screen.

[i]Developers note: I expect this will be most useful for turning off these features for INSTANT mode: although initial rotation, movement, and hold systems do make sense in theory for INSTANT mode, they are unusual for this style of play. For now the default is on for every mode, but depending on community feedback I may turn these off by default for INSTANT.[/i]

[*] Changed spawn positions of CONSOLE mode pieces to use right sided bias for better accuracy to classic inspiration.

[i]Developers note: This change ensures classic players don't have to relearn tap counts if they choose to play with a style without DAS. Sorry about this unintentional inaccuracy! Thanks to all the players continuing to help me improve these classic themed modes.[/i]

[*] Added text to unlock screen explaining where unlocks are selected
[*] Adjusted volume and filtering for soft drop collision sound in INSTANT mode
[*] Added more detailed error messages for the rare cases when saving or loading fails. This should help me narrow down system specific issues like file system permissions problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.0.4 Hotfix
notes.content:
Another smaller update fixing some gameplay bugs. I appreciate the reports! I'm planning another update this week to add some new control options--this was originally planned for today but I wanted to get theses fixes out first. During the busy launch period I'll also be maintaining a "Known Issues / Planned Improvements" post so you can check what's coming soon. Thanks for your continued support!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing spins from being detected in ARCADE mode when the spin ends with the T piece pointing up.
[*] Made 180 degree rotation more consistent with normal rotation with respect to initial rotation system.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
This is another small update fixing a couple of bugs. Thanks for reporting them! I'm planning a slightly larger update in a couple of days which will add some new control options based on community feedback.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash when using SDR setting of 0 and playing the Monochrome/Console mode.
[*]The Symbols block style used in the Tutorial and Chaos modes is now unlocked by default instead of showing "UNLOCK TUTORIAL" on the unlocks screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.0.2 Hotfix
notes.content: After last nights hot fix correcting a bug in the ARCADE rotation system I went through and double checked the other "classic" rotation systems and found some more inaccuracies / bugs. These have been corrected. Sorry these slipped through! Please let me know if you find anything else out of order.

notes.title: Tetrachroma 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content: This is a quick fix to correct a bug in the ARCADE mode's rotation system. The S and Z pieces rotated incorrectly in this mode. Thank you to Kero for reporting this issue!

notes.title: TETRACHROMA Full Release!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce the full release of Tetrachroma! Compared to the demo version, the full release adds 7 new modes, 25 more puzzles, the ability to play the game in a single stage SPECTRUM style, and bunch of unlockable color palettes and blocks.

There's a lot of new modes being added at once, so I'm sure there will be balance changes and fixes needed. Please let me know on the Steam forums or elsewhere if you have feedback or encounter problems.

Creating this game has been an intense journey for me as I dive deep into a genre I love. I've gotten a lot of joy out of developing this game, and I want to thank everyone that has been a part of that. Thanks to all the demo players and everyone that offered feedback and support!

In addition to the many new modes and puzzles, here's a change list for this version:

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievements added. Unlock 58 achievements by completing modes and challenges.
[*] Added new Unlocks screen. View all the game's block styles and color palettes and see what you've unlocked.
[*] Added advanced controls. You can now bind keys to perform instant 180 rotations and "hard shifts". These are unbound by default.
[*] Added 'Late Lock Rejection Window' option to the controls handling page. After automatic locking, manual locks are ignore for a few frames to prevent accidental late locks. This lets you set this window size or turn it off by setting it to zero.
[*] Added the option to turn off the background in the Preferences menu.
[*] Final stage background changed. The final stage of MARATHON has a new background theme. The old background theme of black and white landscape photos is now used for MONOCHROME/STANDARD in the new SPECTRUM format.
[*] Gameplay Track Brahm's "Intermezzo" has been transposed a step down. Unfortunately large music publishers sometimes issues automated false claims that affect original versions of public domain classical music like the music I made for this game. Although I've not experienced any copyright claims on my own uploads of the game, a player of the demo received a claim from this track on their channel, so the track has been modified to hopefully avoid further automated false claims. If you receive any claims as a result of Tetrachroma gameplay footage, please contact me
[/list]

notes.title: TETRACHROMA releases October 25
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that the full version of TETRACHROMA releases October 25! The full version of the game includes 5+ more gameplay modes to try.
[h3]New modes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] WILD mode: an easier mode that introduces wild colored blocks at stage 1 of the marathon
[*] CONSOLE mode: "retro" mode with classic stacking mechanics
[*] BIG mode: double-sized blocks for extra challenge
[*] CELL mode: small square board with modified piece set
[*] Plus more to discover in game!
[/list]
The full release also features 25 more hand designed puzzles in the game's PUZZLE mode, and a bunch of color palettes and block styles to unlock.

[h3]Demo availability:[/h3]
With the full release of the game, the current demo will no longer be available. Thank you to everyone that has played the demo so far and to players that offered feedback and encouragement. The game is so much better thanks to you! I may develop a new demo in the future, but for now, focusing on just the one version at release will simplify development for me.

I can't wait to share the game with you all!

notes.title: Tetrachroma Demo Update (0.4.1)
notes.content:
This update fixes some minor bugs and adds the option to turn off the game's spawn delay canceling mechanic. Turning off spawn delay canceling makes the gameplay slower, but also gives more time to charge DAS as the pieces spawn.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced "Repeats Cancel Spawn" option with more general purpose "Spawn Delay Cancel" option. This option allows setting the spawn delay cancel mechanic to "OFF", "ON INPUT", or "ON INPUT OR REPEAT". The default is "ON INPUT"
[*] Add wild colored blocks to the block appearance preview in the Preferences menu for Puzzle mode
[*] Changed wild colored block 'jewel' rendering to slightly improve visibility of jewels
[*] Fixed issue where there is garbled text at the end of the URL when opening Steam page from the Full Game menu option
[*] Corrected background shading around the top inner border of the playfield which was off by one pixel
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma Demo Update (0.4.0)
notes.content:
A new visual effect option has been added to the game that highlights which lines will be cleared before a piece is placed. This helps new players learn the core mechanics and experienced players play faster.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Line Clear Preview" option to "Visual Options". This option highlights which lines a piece will clear before it is locked. Defaults to on with the "RGB" setting.
[*] Reworked background image loading code. This change reduces memory (RAM) usage by about 50% by only loading backgrounds for the selected mode.
[*] Increased opacity of "Subtle" setting for "Color Change Preview" option.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma Demo Update (0.3.0)
notes.content:
This update makes balance changes to the game over condition with the goal of making the game feel a little more forgiving. The change makes it easier for new players to play the game for longer and for expert players to get larger line clears.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked game over condition: game over now occurs when a piece is placed with none of its blocks contained inside the board. Previously game over occurred when a piece was placed with any of its blocks contained outside of the board. Special thanks to MelloBoo44 for suggesting this change on the Steam forums.
[*]Added slight board shift when blocks are locked above the board: when blocks are locked above the board frame, the board is shifted down slightly to improve visibility of these blocks.
[*]Added effect where the top of the board's border briefly glows rainbow colors to warn if locking a piece would cause a game over.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma Demo Update (0.2.3)
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a feature which draws 'wild' colored blocks with a 'jewel'. Select the jewel appearance or turn it off in the Preferences menu.
[*]Added an option "Repeats Cancel Spawn" to the "Controls Handling" menu. When "On", holding soft drop or shift can be used to quickly cancel the spawn delay of pieces.
[*]Fixed a bug where hold could be used twice if first used during the spawn delay.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma Demo Update (0.2.2)
notes.content:
I've updated the Tetrachroma Demo to fix a couple of option menu related bugs. Thanks to the everyone for continuing to provide feedback!

[b]Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where exiting from the Graphics Options, Keyboard Mapping, or Controller Mapping screens by pressing Esc instead of selecting Go Back caused the options not to have immediate effect.
[*]Changed the format used for storing gameplay records to make it more compact.
[/list]

notes.title: Tetrachroma Demo Update (0.2.1)
notes.content:
I've updated the Tetrachroma demo with some quality of life improvements and fixes. I plan to release several small updates to the demo as I work toward the full 1.0 release. Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback on the forums and elsewhere!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled Steam Cloud. If you've played the game on multiple machines, please be cautious when resolving any Steam Cloud conflicts.
[*] Added descriptions to the Controls Handling options menu.
[*] Added a tutorial message when you first play Puzzle mode.
[*] Added "total games" to the stats screen when the Endless option is selected.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to write to the save file twice when completing Puzzle mode. In rare cases, this redundant saving could cause issues on certain machines.
[/list]
[b]Note about game saves[/b]:
My goal is to make the full version of the game fully compatible with the demo in terms of stats and progress. However, I'm considering some balance changes to the scoring system and overall difficulty before the full release. If these changes are implemented, a future demo update may reset stats and records related to scores to ensure consistency with the full version. I'll include this information in the patch notes, but I wanted to give you a heads-up if you’d prefer to wait for the complete game.

notes.title: TETRACHROMA Demo available now!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that TETRACHROMA's demo is now available for download! There may be future versions of the demo with different content, but this first demo features: 
[list]
[*] Marathon mode: a 400 line endurance challenge divided into 4 stages each with a different number of colors
[*] Puzzle mode preview: a 15 puzzle preview of the full game's 40 puzzles. Clear flashing blocks from hand designed patterns.
[/list]
Completing the game's Marathon mode is a serious challenge, especially at the higher difficulties, giving you an in-depth look at what the game has to offer.
